Question: Indicate the correct option regarding the quality of life of a patient who goes through three consecutive health conditions with utility values ​​of 0.45 the first, 0.68 the second and 0.95 the third:

opa. The best quality of life corresponds to the third state of health through which it passes.
opb. The best quality of life corresponds to the first state of health through which it passes.
opc. The quality of life depends on the time you are in each state of health.
opd. The utility does not serve to assess the quality of life.
ope. In all three states the quality of life is very bad because they are values ​​less than 1.
